svg.title: J1 First open: load the shop, or start empty, and render the overview

g.text: J1 First open: load the shop, or start empty, and render the overview
an empty "My shop": no customers, no entries;
balance = all credit minus all payments
total outstanding = sum of all balances
todayIso() uses ?today= when it is a valid date
as-of, the date of the figures (extras.js)
a saved extra language is fetched from i18n/
draw on a customer page only (J9, J11, J12);
assist.js (v1.2.5) says what a press did;
load last; on a phone compact.js puts
quick entry in a pill and the other
actions in a + sheet; from 768 px (v1.5)
the overview of a shop with customers is
a total strip, the customer list and the
pill with a + popover, and from 1200 px
a right panel with the entry form,
[page served over https or from localhost]
